exposure: Integrated three-dimensional (3D) manual pelvic reduction, Redcord suspension training, and pelvic belt fixation
outcome: Quality of life (36-Item Short-Form Health Survey)
cohort: The study included 136 patients diagnosed with postpartum pubic symphysis diastasis (PSD).
finding: The combined protocol of 3D pelvic reduction, suspension training, and pelvic belt fixation significantly improved pelvic pain, pubic symphysis narrowing, functional disability, quality of life, and sleep quality in postpartum PSD patients compared to conventional therapy.
